reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his DM. I confirmed his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Thistle rollout is Fridays at 8:30 from now on.

I also told him I have no private memory for each member, so his DM thread with me is the record I'll check when he asks about it. I didn't put it in shared memory, because it could then come up in other members' conversations. As he asked, I took no other action, but I offered to add it to his calendar as a recurring event if he wants.
